sources.title: Original T5 release README
sources.evidence: The original repository snapshot explicitly lists the released T5-Small checkpoint, its Google Cloud Storage location and a nominal 60 million parameters. It describes the text-to-text encoder-decoder framework and calls 512 a default sequence length.

sources.title: Original T5 release commit metadata
sources.evidence: Author time 2019-10-23T23:34:41Z and committer time 2019-10-23T23:52:05Z date the snapshot that already links the released T5-Small weights. February 2020 publicity and later checkpoint conversions do not establish the first release.

sources.title: Original Google T5-Small checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Decoded the 5,974-byte TensorFlow SSTable index without downloading weight shards. Excluding Adafactor slot variables and global_step leaves 131 unique BF16 model tensors with 60,506,624 learned parameters: encoder 18,881,280, decoder 25,175,808, shared embedding 16,449,536. Retained tensor storage bytes equal twice their shape products; there are no partition slices or quantization metadata. Two self-attention relative-bias tables are present, with no cross-attention relative-bias table.

sources.title: Original T5-Small operative configuration
sources.evidence: Six encoder and six decoder blocks, d_model=512, d_ff=2048, d_kv=64 and eight heads. Uses dense ReLU feed-forward layers, shared encoder/decoder embedding and tied decoder embedding/softmax weights. Absolute positional embeddings are disabled. Input/target lengths and max_length are configured to 512; vocabulary padding divisor is 128.

sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.evidence: Describes the original T5 Small dimensions and nominal 60M count, dense encoder-decoder architecture, scale-only layer normalization, relative-position bias, tied embedding/output weights, and text-to-text inputs/outputs. Original T5 uses span-corruption pretraining mixed with supervised tasks. Length 512 describes training/fine-tuning. No dedicated thinking mode, native tool-call interface or separately defined inference active-parameter count is specified.

sources.title: Pinned original T5-Small Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Confirms six blocks per stack, d_model=512, d_ff=2048, d_kv=64, eight heads, vocabulary 32128 and 32 relative-attention buckets. n_positions=512 is configuration metadata, not a learned absolute-position table or a verified universal serving maximum.

sources.title: Pinned T5-Small converted safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only HTTP 206 byte ranges 0-7 and 8-15535, not the weight payload. Header contains 132 F32 tensors totaling 60,506,880 stored elements. A 256-element decoder cross-attention relative-bias tensor is absent from Google's original checkpoint and ignored by the model implementation. Excluding this unused conversion artifact gives the independently verified original total of 60,506,624.

sources.title: T5 model implementation
sources.evidence: Defines dense attention and two-matrix ReLU feed-forward layers, scale-only layer normalization, and tied encoder/decoder/output embeddings. Cross-attention has no relative bias, and T5ForConditionalGeneration explicitly ignores the old converted decoder cross-attention relative-bias key on load. Only the first self-attention block of each stack owns a relative-bias table. Shape-based counting agrees with the original Google index.

sources.title: T5 Small model card
sources.evidence: Heading is T5 Small. Identifies the original Google Research authors, Apache 2.0 license, text-to-text tasks, and C4 span-corruption plus supervised multitask pretraining. This card is authored by Hugging Face; original Google checkpoint metadata independently supplies the exact parameter count.

sources.title: Original T5 Apache License 2.0
sources.evidence: Original released project carries Apache License 2.0, consistent with the exact checkpoint model card.

sources.title: T5X released-model documentation
sources.evidence: Later first-party documentation links the original T5 Small checkpoint at step 1000000 and distinguishes original T5 from T5 1.1, LM-adapted and Flan variants. Original T5 uses supervised multitask pretraining and shared embeddings; later variant dimensions and counts are not transferred. It does not give a separate inference active-parameter count for original T5 Small.

sources.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, Appendix D
sources.evidence: Table D.1 includes the exact T5-Small model with nominal 60M parameters and an active fraction of 0.5 for a simplified training-FLOP estimate. Appendix D explicitly omits attention-operation costs. This comparison is not an original-developer disclosure of a per-token inference active-parameter count and does not establish a 30M active catalog value.

name.note: Original T5 Small, not T5 1.1 Small or Flan-T5 Small. Normalize capitalization to the exact checkpoint card heading.

developer.note: Google Research developed the original model; the report lists individual authors.

release_date.note: The dated original repository snapshot explicitly links the released Small checkpoint. Retain this date rather than later publicity or conversion dates.

open_weights.note: Original Google weights are publicly linked; original tensor index and converted checkpoint header were accessible.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license metadata agrees with the original project license.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned count, 60,506,624 parameters divided by 1e9, not the rounded 60M label. Sum 131 unique BF16 Google model tensors; exclude optimizer slots and global_step. Encoder 18,881,280 + decoder 25,175,808 + shared embedding 16,449,536. Shared encoder/decoder/output embedding counted once. With D=512, I=8*64=512, F=2048, Le=Ld=6, V=32128, B=32, H=8, independent formula V*D + Le*(4*D*I+2*D*F+2*D) + Ld*(8*D*I+2*D*F+3*D) + 2*D + 2*B*H agrees. HF storage includes an extra unused 256-element cross-attention bias, excluded from the original model count.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked original architecture/training report, operative configuration and later first-party T5X documentation; no separately defined per-token inference active-parameter count. Encoder and decoder execute in different inference phases, so dense does not establish active equals total. GPT-3 Appendix D's 0.5 active fraction is simplified training-FLOP accounting, not a suitable inference parameter specification.

architecture.note: Six-block bidirectional encoder and six-block causal decoder with cross-attention; dense ReLU feed-forward layers, relative self-attention bias and scale-only normalization. No mixture-of-experts routing.

context_window.note: The catalog field denotes maximum context. Sources establish 512 training/default input and target lengths, not a universal maximum for this relative-position encoder-decoder checkpoint. Configured max_length and n_positions metadata do not independently verify a universal serving or architectural cap. Relative-bias distance buckets are not a context limit; do not infer unlimited supported context either.

modalities.note: Original text-to-text checkpoint consumes and generates tokenized text.

reasoning.note: No dedicated thinking mode or explicitly trained reasoning capability is established for this exact original checkpoint. Ordinary supervised NLP tasks and later Flan variants are insufficient evidence.

tool_call.note: No native tool/function-call interface or training is documented for this original checkpoint; arbitrary text generation does not establish it.

description.value: Original T5 encoder-decoder model pretrained with span corruption and supervised text-to-text tasks.
description.note: Describes original multitask T5 without transferring T5 1.1 or Flan training or capabilities.

patch.name: T5 Small
patch.description: Original T5 encoder-decoder model pretrained with span corruption and supervised text-to-text tasks.
patch.notes: Released in the October 23, 2019 original repository snapshot. Original Google checkpoint contains 60,506,624 unique learned parameters, counting the shared encoder/decoder/output embedding once and excluding optimizer state. A converted HF checkpoint additionally stores an unused 256-element cross-attention relative-bias tensor, excluded here. Length 512 is the training/default sequence length; a maximum context and separate inference active-parameter count are not established.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for original T5 Small. Corrected capitalization and replaced nominal 60M with the exact original-checkpoint total 60,506,624, independently matching a configuration formula and the converted checkpoint header after excluding an unused 256-element bias. Confirmed October 23, 2019 release, Google, Apache 2.0, open weights and dense text-to-text encoder-decoder architecture. Context maximum, separate inference active count, dedicated reasoning and native tool calls remain null; 512 is a training/default length. Clarified original multitask pretraining.
